steps.instruction: Classify every interrupted restore step as done, not-started, or unknown before any retry is planned.
preconditions: the run journal has been reconciled
stopConditions: an interrupted step's outcome is still unknown
observations: every interrupted step has a recorded done or not-started outcome

stopConditions: a source digest differs from the checkpoint
observations: every retained source digest matches the checkpoint
every restored volume is fully attached or fully detached

steps.instruction: Discard the explicitly listed partially written replicas so the restore can resume from the checkpoint.
preconditions: each target appears on the attachment survey as partially written
a complete replica of the same volume is verified
stopConditions: any target is not on the reviewed partial-replica list
no complete replica of the volume is verified
observations: operator records each discarded replica and its verified complete counterpart

confirmation.prompt: Discard only the listed partially written replicas; this is irreversible.
confirmation.acknowledgeWith: I confirm the listed partial replicas and understand the irreversible data-loss boundary.

steps.instruction: Resume the pinned restore waves from the checkpoint, skipping only steps recorded as done.
preconditions: every source digest matches the checkpoint
stopConditions: a source digest differs from the checkpoint
a wave would retry a step whose outcome is unknown
observations: each resumed wave attaches an artifact-verified receipt

steps.instruction: Confirm the restore receipt set matches the checkpoint manifest before recommission is planned.
stopConditions: a required restore receipt is missing
observations: the restore receipt set matches the checkpoint manifest
